rows.note: Use this as the everyday adverb when an action is permitted by law.

example.english: We can legally set up a stall at the market.
example.traditional: 我哋可以合法咁喺街市擺檔。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 hap6 faat3 gam2 hai2 gaai1 si5 baai2 dong3

rows.note: Use this when discussing a matter from a legal perspective, without necessarily saying that it is permitted.

example.english: Legally speaking, this contract is valid.
example.traditional: 法律上嚟講，呢份合約有效㗎。
example.jyutping: faat3 leot6 soeng6 lai4 gong2 ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3 jau5 haau6 gaa3
